dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: True, you make a good point. I've got to become a more reliable person!

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, just the other day, I told Lady Yae everything that happened, and she seemed rather... inordinately pleased.

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: She even told me, "Why, young Onodera, it's because of people like you that the Irodori Festival is so interesting!"

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: I can't help but feel that there's some other meaning to that...
